guard_pose: loose relaxed stance facing right, the right arm stretched forward at shoulder height pointing one finger like a pistol, the left arm hanging loose, long white coat

jab: lazy flick jab: snaps the pointing front hand straight forward into a quick backhand strike, then lets it drift back into the pointing stance
jab2: palm strike: throws the other open palm straight forward with an unhurried twist of the hips, then back into the stance
jab3: front kick: lifts the front knee and kicks straight forward at belly height with a small flash of blue spiritual energy, then back into the stance
dashattack: Sonido rush: glides forward in a blur and rams ahead shoulder first with a flash of blue spiritual energy, coat flaring behind him, then stops and stands back up in the relaxed stance
fsmash: point-blank cero: draws the pointing hand back beside his head, then thrusts it forward at full extension like firing a pistol and a burst of blue cero energy explodes at the fingertip, the arm kicking up with the recoil, then recovers into the stance
usmash: upward cero: bends the knees, then thrusts the pointing hand straight up above his head and a burst of blue cero energy explodes at the fingertip, then lowers it back into the stance
dsmash: low split kicks: drops low and kicks fast in front at foot level, then spins and kicks behind him, small bursts of blue spiritual energy flashing at each foot, then back into the stance
nair: neutral aerial: spins once in mid-air with his long coat flaring out as a ring of blue spiritual energy flashes around his body, then opens up again
fair: forward aerial: a powerful flying kick straight forward in mid-air with a flash of blue spiritual energy at the foot, then pulls the leg back in
dair: down aerial: stomps straight down beneath him with both feet in mid-air with a burst of blue spiritual energy, then pulls the legs back up

nspecial: Cero: keeps the arm stretched forward pointing one finger like a pistol, a small sphere of blue spiritual energy gathers at the fingertip, then a short thick blast of blue cero fires straight forward from the finger with a recoil of the arm, then he lowers the hand back into the stance
sspecial: Los Lobos: lazily raises the pointing hand, a faint blue glow gathers around it, then he flicks the finger forward like firing a pistol and sweeps the arm ahead as if sending something running forward, then lets the arm drop back into the stance; nothing else is drawn
uspecial: upward Sonido: crouches slightly and vanishes in a flicker leaving a fading afterimage, then reappears in mid-air with a burst of blue spiritual energy around his body, coat fluttering below him, arms loose
dspecial: rapid ceros: aims the pointing hand straight forward and fires six small blue cero bolts one after another from the fingertip, the arm kicking up slightly with each shot, then lowers the hand back into the stance
ultimate: Cero Metralleta: a flash of blue light, a long silver pistol appears in each of his hands, he aims both arms straight forward and fires a furious rapid stream of small blue cero bolts from both muzzles, the arms shaking with the recoil, then braces and fires one big blue cero blast from both pistols together, then the pistols dissolve into light and he returns to the stance
w0_sspecial: the pack: raises the pointing hand as blue spiritual energy flares around it, then flicks the finger forward twice like firing a pistol and sweeps the arm wide ahead as if unleashing a pack, then lets the arm drop back into the stance; nothing else is drawn
w0_ultimate: Los Lobos hunt: stands lazily and raises the pointing hand forward, blue spiritual energy pulses around his body, he flicks the finger forward three times like firing a pistol, each flick with a small blue flash, then sweeps the whole arm forward with an open hand in a commanding gesture, then the glow fades and he returns to the stance; nothing else is drawn
w1_nspecial: twin Cero: brings both hands forward one above the other, both pointing like pistols, a large sphere of blue spiritual energy gathers in front of the fingertips, then a wide blast of blue cero fires straight forward with a strong recoil, then he lowers the hands back into the stance
w1_ultimate: Resurreccion, Los Lobos: raises one hand, streams of white light swirl in from beside him and flow into both his hands, he spreads his arms as blue spiritual pressure erupts around him like a storm, a shockwave of blue energy blasts outward, then the burst settles and he returns to the stance

walk: walks forward lazily to the right in side profile, the front arm still stretched forward pointing like a pistol, the other arm hanging loose: the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, the body and head stay turned to the right the whole time exactly like the first frame, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose
crouch: squats down very low on the spot: knees fully bent, hips dropped almost to the heels, back bent forward, the front hand still pointing forward like a pistol
